'''Kahyin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was stationed in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and frequented the [[Nexus Room]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].

==Behind the scenes==
Major Kahyin appears as a Social Items Vendor on Dromund Kaas in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
